test_title: PYST 27: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.**

Happiness is not something you ___________ (adjourn) for the future. It is something you design for the present.
solution: The correct answer is: **Postpone** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The sentence means that happiness should not be delayed for the future, but should be created in the present. • **Adjourn **means to postpone or suspend a meeting, session, or activity. (किसी बैठक, सत्र या गतिविधि को स्थगित या निलंबित करना) • **Example**: *The judge decided to adjourn the court proceedings until the following day.* • Marked option **Postpone **means to delay or reschedule an event. (किसी घटना को विलंबित या पुनर्निर्धारित करना) • **Example**: *Due to the heavy rain, they had to postpone the outdoor concert to the next weekend.* • So, the synonym for "adjourn" is "postpone". Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Decimate **means to destroy or kill a large portion of something. (किसी चीज़ के बड़े हिस्से को नष्ट या नष्ट करना) • **Rejuvenate **means to restore or revive something. (किसी चीज़ को पुनर्स्थापित या पुनर्जीवित करना) • **Constitute **means to form or make up something. (कुछ बनाना) 34:Tb5f, The correct answer is: "**that are abundant**."
